text:
Sofia Martinez: Quick sync request: OpalField sent their power/throughput specimens. Need a compact public bench and an expanded tech appendix. Thoughts?
Liam Brooks: Compact = one model FP16, seq 512, single batch sizes for public. Appendix can show fp16 vs int8 and a perf/W table.
OF-infra: OF Infra: we recommend FP16 public, int8 appendix. We can provide calibrated fan curves and a power baseline trace.
Clara Tan: I'll curate the prompt set. Suggest: (1) short chat prompt (avg 40 tokens), (2) long context generation (avg 1500 tokens), (3) bulk embedding run (1M items simulated).
Sofia Martinez: Good. Minimal public matrix: FP16, seq 512, batches [1,16], 30min steady-state throughput for perf/W snapshot. Appendix: FP16 vs INT8, seq 128/2048, KV cache cold/warm.
Liam Brooks: For perf/W measurement we need sync on sampling rate. Our bench expects 1s resolution CSV with headers: timestamp_utc,power_w,board_temp_c,gpu_util_pct,ambient_c. Please gzip and place under s3://redwood-partner/opalfield/1761245678/raw/.
OF-infra: Understood. We'll push gzipped CSVs in UTC. We'll include a measurement_methods.md with sensor calibration details and room ambient notes.
bench-bot: bench-bot: Ingest requirements: UTC timestamps, gzipped CSV, UTF-8, file pattern opf-<runid>-power.csv.gz. Example command:
```
OPF_RUN=opal-1761245678
python bench/collect_power.py --board OF-A100X --out ${OPF_RUN}-power.csv.gz --interval 1 --duration 1800
```
Clara Tan: For kernel experiments, can we keep label scheme: baseline, ofp-patchA, ofp-patchA+vf32? Also include git sha and build image name in artifacts.
OF-infra: We'll tag kernels: ofp-stock-2026, ofp-a1, ofp-a1-vf32. Git SHAs included. Build images pushed to quay.opalfield.io/opal/bench:<tag>.
Sofia Martinez: Timeline idea: dry-run on our lab (OF-A100X) tomorrow 09:00 PT, partner smoke Friday 11:00 PT, full sweep next Mon-Wed. Who's owning what?
Liam Brooks: I'll own runner orchestration and upload. Using image quay.io/redwood/bench-runner:2026-03-24. Will pin node with taints for OpalField hw.
OF-infra: We'll have two engineers on call during the Friday smoke and will deliver CSVs by EOD today for dry-run.
Clara Tan: I'll open the prompt harness PR and add eval scripts (throughput calc, watt/token, p99 latency).
bench-bot: bench-bot: Checklist created: ingest schema, run command snippet, kernel tags, s3 path, harness PR link. Reminder scheduled: Friday 10:30 PT to #partnerships.
Sofia Martinez: Ok. Public messaging: short blurb only after we validate quality. Ryan will need a one-line marketplace summary once results are stable.
Liam Brooks: Add reproducibility notes: exact model hash, tokenizer seed, and random seed in artifacts.
OF-infra: We'll attach the model tarball hash and dockerfile in artifacts.
Sofia Martinez: Great. I'll run the dry-run and post numbers here. Ping me if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
